reason: The migration creates `embeddable_hosts` with no unique index (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:3-7) and the model only has a format validation on host (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2), so duplicate hosts with different categories can be saved. `record_for_host` then returns `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17), which silently picks one row (in practice the lowest id, not truly random) to decide the embed category.
